capabilities.description: CSV/Excel lead files are parsed into lead records (name, phone, language, project tag) and held as a durable dial list. Daily call cap and concurrency are reserve-policy settings on the queue; retry backoff for busy/no-answer (max 3 spaced attempts) and per-language best-call-window are computed rat

Each lead's call lifecycle runs as an explicit state machine — queued, dialing, answered, pitched, qualified, transferred, callback, closed — with the configured call-window schedule enforced as a guard on transitions, keyed to the call's SID.

PSI project sheets (price lists, payment plans, handover dates) are ingested through the retrieval pipeline and pitched per project tag with no hard-coded scripts. Claims about price, handover date, or payment plan are cited from retrieved documents or withheld — cite-or-refuse applied exactly where

Twilio Programmable Voice wrapper: originate outbound call, ASR gather in English and Arabic, Polly Neural TTS, and status-callback events (initiated / ringing / answered / completed / failed / busy / no-answer) mapped onto workflow transitions keyed by Call SID. Ships with the Twilio edge stubbed u

On a qualifying outcome: collect the conversation summary, dial the broker leg, whisper the private summary to the broker only via TTS, conference-bridge both parties, and return the transfer outcome. Validated as a bridge sequence against the same fake-Twilio harness.

Qualification is a schema, not prose: outcome is one enum — project_interested, other_re_interested, not_interested — alongside collected fields (property type, budget, area, timeline). The broker summary is structured from that record rather than written freehand.

Every call writes its outcome through the route-persists pattern and each call event is appended to an audit ledger, so attempt, answer, and transfer history survive restarts and are reconstructable per call SID.

The outbound destination for call outcome plus broker summary is unstated, so CRM integration ships as a marked placeholder — a stubbed connector that records intent and shape without claiming a working integration. Activated when a CRM destination is named.

summary: CallOps is an outbound AI voice-calling platform for a real-estate brokerage, built first for PSI. It ingests brokerage lead files, queues and paces dials against calling windows and caps, pitches real project numbers retrieved from ingested project sheets under a cite-or-refuse discipline, qualifies each conversation into a fixed three-outcome vocabulary with collected fields, and hands warm leads to a human broker through a whispered summary and conference bridge.
